name: io.github.dfmi-app/dfmi-market
title: dfmi x402 market
description: Shop the dfmi x402 agent market: find services, get quotes, free test dUSD, capped buying.

environmentVariables.name: DFMI_BUYER_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional throwaway buyer key. If unset, dfmi_create_wallet makes one in ~/.dfmi.

environmentVariables.name: DFMI_SESSION_BUDGET
environmentVariables.description: Total spend cap per server run (default 1.00).

environmentVariables.name: DFMI_ALLOW_MAINNET
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to allow mainnet payments. Off by default.
